metadata.title: Cursor Rules for MoneyGraph: MDC Configuration Deep Dive
metadata.description: Deep dive into MoneyGraph's Cursor rules file. Learn how our MDC configuration teaches Cursor the SDK patterns, namespace hierarchy, and compliance requirements.
metadata.author: MoneyGraph Team

seo.og_title: Cursor + MoneyGraph: MDC Rules for Payment Integration
seo.og_description: Our MDC rules file teaches Cursor the MoneyGraph SDK. Quote → Confirm → Payout, KYC compliance, error handling—all automatic.

content.intro: Cursor is the AI-first IDE that's taken the developer world by storm. MoneyGraph SDK has supported Cursor since v1.0, but with v2.2, we've completely rewritten our rules for the new v2.1+ namespace structure.

frontmatter.description: The .cursor/rules/moneygraph.mdc file uses Cursor's MDC format:
frontmatter.example:
---
description: MoneyGraph Fintech SDK Standards
globs: ["**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx", "**/*.js", "**/*.jsx"]
alwaysApply: true
---
explanations: globs — Rules apply to all TypeScript and JavaScript files
alwaysApply — Rules are active even without explicit mention

critical_rules.description: Our rules file defines four non-negotiable patterns:

why_cursor.heading: Why Cursor Loves MoneyGraph
why_cursor.body:
Cursor's strength is understanding complex codebases. Our SDK's clean namespace hierarchy (mg.module.submodule.method) maps perfectly to how Cursor thinks about code structure.

Combined with our MDC rules, Cursor becomes a fintech expert that understands compliance, rate locking, and multi-rail payments.
